_comment: Single source of truth for Dr Ahmed Hesham's entity data (schema.org Person #drhesham) and the author byline / author box. Every Person node with @id #drhesham on every page is rebuilt from this file at build (src/lib/schema.mjs), and verify.mjs fails if a page disagrees. coachingSince = the owner-confirmed start year (2 Nov 2026: 2018, the About timeline). The 'N+ years' counters use completed years only (build year - coachingSince - 1), so they are true whatever the start month was. The credential slots (alumniOf, hasCredential, identifier, twitter) stay EMPTY until the owner supplies them: never fill them from a guess.
